upstream_provenance.source_context: Independent OH DataRescueAbility registers only picker and offline channel, queries launchMode before normal Dart service/logger/preference initialization. Native N-API worker calls maintenance Rust ABI without Core handle; structured response/free-string boundary inspected. Shared normal-runtime lease versus exclusive rescue lease prevents cooperating writers, pending durable publication blocks ordinary startup. Source implements authenticated/encrypted archive manifest, bounded reads, exact membership/hash verification, staged publication, retained roots and explicit journal resume. Multiple renames are not a whole-root atomic transaction. Separate ability does not itself establish separate process; normal holders must release leases. Source guards and crypto declarations are not an audit of race freedom, cryptography, power-loss durability or recovery completeness. Final OH factory and ability source rechecked. Later root validation allows platform symlinked ancestors while checking selected root/descendants. No OH recovery build or execution; app GPL-family/AGPL registry license retained; no app implementation copied.
